content:
Poseidon is Russian nuclear powered nuclear armed underwater drone/torpedo capable of autonomously advancing to the shores of a potential enemy and remaining in "sleep" mode until receiving an activation command. #Russia 

Current carrier of Poseidon torpedo is Russian submarine K-329 Belgorod it can carry 6x of those torpedo's.

Currently there are another two submarines on construction specially designed to carry Poseidon nuclear torpedo.

Main takeaways from Izvestia article

Poseidon is capable of moving at great depth at high speed, representing a technological reserve in case of the development of missile and anti-submarine defense of a potential enemy. The main objectives of the system are to defeat naval bases and naval groups. The expert also did not rule out that the multipurpose ocean system could perform other tasks, including reconnaissance missions and the laying of minefields.

"In addition, when Poseidon was mentioned back in 2018, it was referred to as a multipurpose ocean system. Accordingly, presumably, it can perform some other tasks besides delivering a nuclear charge. There may be mini-barrages or reconnaissance missions. In addition, this system requires a separate media. A special purpose is being built for him in a submarine, which is also an important point," Stefanovic added.

On October 29, Russian President Vladimir Putin announced during a visit to the P.V. Mandryk Central Military Clinical Hospital in Moscow that Russia had conducted tests of the Poseidon underwater vehicle. The Russian leader noted that for the first time it was possible not only to launch the device from a launch vehicle using a launch engine, but also to activate a nuclear installation that allowed the device to operate for a certain time.
